messages:
mira_sales: Hey team — LumenPay (fintech) wants a 2-week POC: Dedicated in us-east, VPC peering, streaming SSE with function/tool-calls, and structured JSON outputs for transaction enrichment. They asked for pricing for ~100 concurrent streams (~60 qps aggregate) + short-lived creds + KMS. Can SE/Eng/Security confirm feasibility and ballpark cost?

devraj_se: Do they require data to stay in customer network (on-prem) or is VPC peering enough? Dedicated vs Private affects lead time.

mira_sales: VPC peering should be fine for now. They want audit logs and KMS. PII will be redacted by app but kept for enrichment keys.

eng-ryan: :wave: We can support SSE streaming + function calls. For 100 concurrent active sessions hitting ~60 qps, recommend 4-6 reserved A100s (quantized), can do a 2-week trial on a short-term reserved plan.
  Ballpark pricing: ~$12k/week for Dedicated reserved capacity + infra — rough estimate; final after exact QPS and model choice.

security-ana: Need completed security questionnaire. We support customer KMS via external key import and SAML SSO. For POC we can enable limited audit retention (30 days). Please confirm who will own keys and whether logs can be shipped to customer's SIEM.

devraj_se: Short-lived creds: yes, we provide ephemeral tokens via our token-service. Example (rotate every 15m):
```
# request ephemeral token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/ephemeral-tokens \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <service-key>" \
  -d '{"client_id":"lumenpay-poc","ttl":900}'
```

devx-hiro: For structured output, use our structured output flag and pass a JSON schema. Example request (python):
```
client.generate(stream=True, model="rwd/open-structured-1", structured_output=True, schema={"type":"object","properties":{"tx_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"}}})
```
This will emit chunked JSON blobs you can parse per-event. Use a small validation set to avoid silent regressions.

mira_sales: Great. Action items: (1) I'll attach the security questionnaire when I get it. (2) @eng-ryan can you drop a one-page cost/instance matrix by EOD? (3) @devraj_se please share ephemeral token sample and handshake notes with integrator. (4) Schedule tech deep-dive with LumenPay Wed 10:00am PST.

eng-ryan: On it. Will post numbers and a quick config snippet.

devraj_se: I'll DM about token-service integration and sample websocket handshake. Also flagging: if they use function/tool-calls, advise a timeout of 10s on external tool responses to keep latency predictable.

mira_sales: Thanks all :thumbsup:
